notes.title: New (little) update is out!
notes.notes:
Dear all,

we've just released a patch with the following changes:

fixed not correctly working torpedo reloading when returning to base
fixed spelling errors
fixed temperature gauge
fixed issues with wider screens
fixed possible loading errors
changed some graphics


Thank you so much for your patience over all the time. We've had quite some difficult times in the past even though that doesn't excuse our absense.

All the best to you and your families and have a fantastic 2021!

notes.title: Another small update is out!
notes.notes:
Dear all,

we roll out another update which fixes some nasty load/save issues which could happen under some circumstances.

BUGFIX:
- fixed unnecessary saving when pausing the game
- fixed loading/saving issues
- fixed wrong positioning of training target
ADDED:
- logging for further bug investigation
